title: OpenFront Chat — Relay Metrics — TEST
description: Live analytics for the openfront-chat relay (stage=test)

queries.query: SELECT last_value(value ORDER BY _timestamp) AS v FROM "oftc_active_connections" WHERE stage = 'test'
SELECT last_value(value ORDER BY _timestamp) AS v FROM "oftc_active_users_5m" WHERE stage = 'test'
SELECT last_value(value ORDER BY _timestamp) AS v FROM "oftc_active_ips_5m" WHERE stage = 'test'

panels.title: Active rooms
panels.description: Rooms with at least one connected socket

queries.query: SELECT sum(v) AS total FROM (SELECT last_value(value ORDER BY _timestamp) AS v, room_type FROM "oftc_active_rooms" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY room_type) AS t

panels.title: Messages per interval, by mode
panels.description: Total chat messages broadcast, split by mode

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1, mode AS breakdown_1 FROM "oftc_messages_sent_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Filter drops, by reason
panels.description: Messages the server dropped by content filter

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1, reason AS breakdown_1 FROM "oftc_filter_hits_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1 FROM "oftc_ws_connections_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1 FROM "oftc_ws_disconnects_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.50) AS y_axis_1 FROM "oftc_verify_duration_ms" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.95) AS y_axis_1 FROM "oftc_verify_duration_ms" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Rate-limit hits
panels.description: Messages / connections rejected by rate limits, by kind

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1, kind AS breakdown_1 FROM "oftc_rate_limit_hits_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.50) AS y_axis_1 FROM "oftc_message_length_chars" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.95) AS y_axis_1 FROM "oftc_message_length_chars" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Auth failures
panels.description: Handshake rejections at the relay, by reason

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1, reason AS breakdown_1 FROM "oftc_auth_failures_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Room-full rejections
panels.description: Connections rejected because a room was at capacity

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1, room_type AS breakdown_1 FROM "oftc_room_full_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Age-gate decisions, by country
panels.description: Verdict per (country, verdict). verdict = pass | reject | no_client_flag. Threshold table lives in relay-example/geo.js.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1, country AS breakdown_1 FROM "oftc_age_gate_decisions_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Age-gate decisions, by verdict
panels.description: Same metric grouped by verdict — quick view of reject vs pass rates.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, sum(value) AS y_axis_1, verdict AS breakdown_1 FROM "oftc_age_gate_decisions_total" WHERE stage = 'test' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
